blocks.text: Michelle Dee said she still has more to show on the international pageant stage as she is set to participate in the upcoming Miss Grand International (MGI) All Stars 2026 competition. Dee’s participation was announced online while the red carpet premiere of her latest film, GMA Pictures’ satirical movie “Red Crown,” was taking place on Monday, Oct. 26, in Ortigas. Dee received cheers from her fellow beauty queens and supporters as she expressed her gratitude for the positive reaction following the announcement of her participation. “Back in 2023, I’m so grateful na kahit hindi ko nauwi ang korona ko tinanggap niyo […]...
